notes.title: Version 1.0.4 - ... Minor Infestation
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33606449/9bfb2133aba681cac0d2f254afde40d68361d50c.png
Hi Everyone, 

Addressed even more bugs & issues with the previous version of the game. See below for the details:


 Fixed some inconsistencies with loading saved games
 Addressed another show-stopping bug on Episode 3 - Elevator scene (Thanks @DJ Archangel)
 Addressed some jumbled audio in Episode 3 -  Elevator Scene
 Turned on all past patrons for Elevator Scene.
 Saves between episodes are now distinct 
 Soul % is now being saved correctly - Finally
 Fixed bug where you were unable to gain soul in episode 2 & 3.


Reminder that a playable demo (all of episode 1) available on New Grounds and Kongregate!  
Finish the demo and learn a secret code to unlock something nice in the Full Game!

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 - Squashing a few Bugs!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33606449/650c66b04235de771b997ea4334a47283477751c.png
Hi Everyone, 

Addressed some small bugs & issues with the previous version of the game. See below for the details:


 Steam overlay fix - Achievements pop-ups are back! 
 Reduced time it takes to return to the home screen after completing an episode
 Addressed a show-stopping bug on Episode 3 - Elevator scene
 Saves between episodes are now distinct 
 Soul % is now being saved correctly


Additionally, I've released a playable demo (all of episode 1) available on New Grounds and Kongregate!  
Finish the demo and learn a secret code to unlock something nice in the Full Game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Hot Fix
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33606449/b151ef8e577ba447aac97ae833db651205c9025a.png
Hi Everyone, 

It's been reported that achievement pop-ups were causing an issue. 

For the time being, they've (the pop-ups) has been disabled in episodes. 

Instead, a success sound is played and the achievement is added to your steam account, once certain criteria are met.
